title: ID0425700-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/R0 300000002001]OCPP pending from offline to online
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
we have the problem, that the Sicharge D from our customer ÖAMTC with ID
Rl17yi
is pending from offline to online in OCPP Backend.
In SCB it stays online permanently.
We have been on site and had very good signal strength with all common network providers on our phones. And the charger is also installed outdoors.
The Router Configuration (APN, Pin etc.) is configured correctly
We also tried different SIM cards.
Is it maybe possible, that the antennas were not installed correctly in the factory??
Solution: N/A
yyyy-mm-dd: N/A

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0425700-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/R0 300000002001]OCPP pending from offline to online CRM:02681000192
additional_info.body:
Hi Johannes,
Pardon for Late response.
We have investigated the logs for over a period of 4weeks, and We have couple of observations.
In the logs, We could see that OCPP connection is requested from the Charger side. But ping from charger is not responded by pong from OCPP server.
Also, We could see it is connecting to OCPP after every 5 mins.
We need following information from your side.
Could you pls confirm if
'WebSocketPingInterval' to 30 seconds and 'HeartbeatInterval' to 180 seconds from OCPP side.
What is the name of the Backend?
Could you pls confirm if Successful backend Intergration with SichargeD have been performed?
Looking forward to hear back from you.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
